prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1331; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, and cognitive complaints consistent with concussion. The mechanism and force of the collision align well with the injury described. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly support the diagnosis. Remote history includes a minor strain involving the same region of the neck and upper back, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Over the course of care, the patient completed 24 visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for an injury of this type, with gradual improvement in symptoms, balance, and tolerance for screen work and reading. Billing records reflect single, appropriately itemized charges for each service, with no duplicate entries. Current status shows near-resolution of symptoms, with a plan for graduated return to activity and follow-up as needed.
